title: Cigarroa Asks if Democrats in Charge Want to Expand Early Voting at Nov. 13 Council Meeting
excerpt: At a Nov. 13 special City Council meeting to canvass the November 2026 election results, District 3 Councilmember Melissa Cigarroa asked City Secretary Maldonado whether the Democrats in charge want to expand early voting. Maldonado answered yes, and Cigarroa said, “That would be excellent. I agree.”
content:
A discussion about election administration took a partisan turn at a special Laredo City Council meeting on Thursday, Nov. 13, called to canvass the results of the November 2026 election.

During the meeting, City Secretary Maldonado suggested that future elections could eventually eliminate the break between the end of early voting and Election Day, allowing voting to continue without interruption.

District 3 Councilmember Melissa Cigarroa responded by asking, “Are you suggesting, because the Democrats are in charge, and perhaps they want to expand the ability to early vote and expand the voting population?”

Maldonado answered, “Yes.” Cigarroa replied, “That would be excellent. I agree.”

The exchange was captured on video from the Nov. 13 special meeting, which Hammrod News Laredo TX shared early Saturday, Nov. 15.

The council must canvass the November election results by Nov. 17.

Source: Video of the City Council Special Meeting, Nov. 13, 2026, as shared by Hammrod News Laredo TX, Nov. 15, 2026.
